name: generate_image
description: Generate an AI image using Perchance (free, no login). Supports 36+ art styles, multiple shapes, and batch generation.

style.description: Art style preset key (e.g., ghibli, cyberpunk, oil_painting, anime, photorealistic). Use 'list' to see all. Default: no_style

count.description: Number of images to generate (1-4). Default: 1

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid in the image. Default: low-quality, deformed, blurry, bad art
